title: Elokapina protest at Finnish Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry against EU CAP reform
location: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, Kruununhaka, Helsinki
participants_original: About 80 participants, according to police as reported by Yle.
threshold_50_evidence: Yle reports the police estimate of about 80 people at the protest.

start_date.summary: Yle dates the gathering to 18 November 2020.

end_date.summary: Yle reports it began shortly before 09:00 and continued until 14:00.

location.summary: In front of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry in Kruununhaka, Helsinki.

demands.summary: Elokapina explicitly called on Finland’s Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry to accurately describe climate/environment effects and submit a climate-oriented Finnish national CAP plan; Yle reports the ministry was hosting a CAP webinar during the gathering.

participants.summary: About 80 per police estimate relayed by Yle.

state_target.summary: Organizer release explicitly directs demands to Finland’s Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry and the national CAP plan. The Government later reports its ministry representatives spoke with Elokapina representatives after the webinar.

notes: Direct state target is now documented by the organizer release about the Ministry and Finland national plan. Government page corroborates post-webinar meeting between Ministry and Elokapina representatives. The 15 Nov individual hunger strike is a separate action, not merged into the 18 Nov gathering. Coding remains proposed and pending independent scientific review.

title: Fixit demonstration calling for Finland to leave the EU and the Finnish government to resign
organizer: Fixit demonstration; exact organizer unknown in captured story
participants_original: Hundreds; Yle cites hundreds at the gathering and reports some hundreds in the Finnish-language coverage search result.
threshold_50_evidence: Yle reports hundreds of people in front of Parliament; comfortably above 50.

start_date.summary: Yle dates the event to Saturday 28 November 2020.

location.summary: In front of Parliament House in downtown Helsinki.

demands.summary: Called for Finland to leave the EU and the current government to resign.

participants.summary: Hundreds per Yle; the Finnish police reportedly estimated “some hundreds” in Finnish-language results.

threshold_50.summary: Yle article body calls the gathering hundreds of people.

state_target.summary: Explicit demand for the Finnish government to resign; also demand to change Finland’s EU membership.

notes: The article reports party-affiliated elected speakers, but this is described as a demonstration with demands against the sitting government and Finland’s EU policy; no upcoming-election rally purpose is reported. End time/endpoint and violence remain unknown.

title: Separate Mannerheimintie vehicle demonstration against a fuel-tax increase
participants_original: Police estimated about 100 cars; number of people and simultaneous crowd size are unknown.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established: about 100 vehicles does not by itself count individual participants at one gathering.

start_date.summary: Yle reports a separate demonstration held about the same time on 28 November.

demands.summary: Participants protested an increase in fuel tax.

participants.summary: Police estimate of about 100 cars; no individual person count.

threshold_50.summary: Unknown because the vehicle estimate is not a person count or clear simultaneous headcount.

state_target.summary: Tax demand concerns Finnish fuel-tax policy.

notes: Keep separate from Fixit rally, as Yle explicitly describes a separate motor demonstration. Vehicle count is not substituted for participant count.
